reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the rendered redline leaves all three paragraphs unchanged with no counterparty comment, which is what a compliant finding should look like.

Cited text supports the classification: p0086 grants an express conformance-to-Specifications warranty for the acceptance period plus one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date (and longer while under Maintenance), meeting or exceeding the preferred 12-month software warranty; p0077 supplies a no-charge repair remedy and p0057 a full refund during the acceptance period.
No 'AS IS' or implied-warranty disclaimer is present in the cited material, so the express warranty is not swallowed — the walk-away scenario does not apply.

Shortfalls versus the preferred wording (no professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, no compliance-with-laws or no-malicious-code warranty, 'best efforts' repair rather than an unqualified repair/replace/refund election) are correctly noted in the rationale as minor sub-elements rather than escalated to a deviation, consistent with the playbook's classification semantics.
Deterministic warranty-period check passes (period expressed in years), corroborating the substance of the rationale.
